description.value: Grouse Mountain is a major mountain resort overlooking Metro Vancouver, accessed from the base station on Nancy Greene Way via the iconic Skyride gondola. The mountain hosts a lift-accessed bike park with rentals and structured lessons, as well as the world-famous Grouse Grind trail that climbs directly from the base—making it a natural destination for cycling-adjacent outdoor adventurers. A new gravity coaster, ziplines, wildlife habitat, and multiple summit dining venues round out the experience.

address.value: 6400 Nancy Greene Way, North Vancouver, BC
